sdc:
create_clock -name main -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks main]
set_input_delay -clock main 0.6 [get_ports a]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports a]
set_output_delay -rise -clock main 0.5 [get_ports y]
set_output_delay -fall -clock main 0.6 [get_ports y]
set_output_delay -clock main 0.2 [get_ports z]
set_output_delay -rise -clock main 0.5 [get_ports w]
set_output_delay -fall -clock main 0 [get_ports w]
